description: This file manages Twitch OAuth access token resolution, supporting configuration and environment variable sources, with priority rules and token normalization.

methods.name: normalizeTwitchToken
methods.description: Ensures the Twitch token has the 'oauth:' prefix, normalizing raw input.

methods.name: resolveTwitchToken
methods.description: Resolves the Twitch OAuth token from config or environment, following priority rules.
